cookSays.line: 📖 Your hands remember: weave cloth (3 plant fiber — strip it from cleared brush), and build a Water Filter (cloth + charcoal from fire ashes). Dirty water doesn't have to stay dirty.

You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Colton Rios. Dry cleaner. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Dispatcher's headset, Trail compass, Photo album, Lucky Coin, Search locket. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. You heard it in the dark. Breathing. Not yours. It knew your name — it said it wrong, like it learned the shape of the sound but not what it meant.
The fire burns lower than it should. Nobody wants to be the one to go for wood in the dark.
You push through the doors into open air. Haven grounds — tents, a fire pit, worn paths. The world is that way.
🍲 A man, maybe 60s is hunched over their bowl by the fire, eating like it matters.
Recipe: Bark armor (Level 1). You have seen bark armor. Plates of bark laced together, worn like a shell.

"The whiskers go rigid — then lash." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Sofia says "Say that again — slower." Bertin asks "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

A faint crackling, and the hairs on your arms lift." "The crackling fades. It slides backward into the black water, done spending itself — for now." The air itself flinches." "It waddles left, then is suddenly right — a feint, testing whether your eyes or your ears are in charge." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Nadia says "Did it look at you? Before?" Imani asks "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

Watch the birds — when they go quiet, the pack is already moving." "The pack circles — nips from the edge, never committing." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Nathan says "And you're still standing." Angelo says quietly "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
